nodes.body: Merged-main source and host-test witness at 34d05bc659a keeps this row evidence-bound. The r300-r2vb-reingest-state oracle proves packet predicates and dword accounting only; it does not execute PM4 or establish radeon CS-validator acceptance. No current-main RS482 dmesg or retained gated DRM_RADEON_CS run is available here, so this row remains open. The required evidence is an exact-SHA gated run with R300_HB_TCL=1, R300_R2VB_TIMING=submit, R300_RAW_SUBMIT_ACCEPTED=1, retained dmesg before/after, and a bounded CS/completion outcome. A validator rejection, dmesg validation error, reset, or completion failure falsifies the source-only boundary.

The current C1C path remains hardware-bound. The RS482 host has PCI 1002:5974 and radeon, but dmesg is denied by the host policy; the gated C1C probe reaches the existing R300_HB_TCL=1 assertion instead of a CS-validator result. I leave this thread unresolved until the required dmesg and direct RS482 PM4/runtime witness are available.
